title: News is More than a Collection of Facts: Moral Frame Preserving News Summarization
reasoning: The paper focuses on the 'moral dimension of framing' in news articles, using Moral Foundation Theory (MFT) as a framework to identify moral-laden words and judgments. It evaluates how LLMs preserve these moral frames in generated summaries, introducing specific metrics like MoralCount and MoralDivergence to measure ethical frame preservation.
